title: Extract the hardcoded 'לימוד' stage-name sentinel to a shared constant
why: DomainTermLabels.resolveStoredStageName documents this literal as the canonical sentinel matched via HebrewTerms.stageNameMap to resolve the correct localized stage name at render time — it is load-bearing, not decorative. It's independently hand-typed in 3 separate files (2 sites in this batch's paired lib file) with no shared constant tying them together; a typo in one copy would silently break resolveStoredStageName's lookup for stages created by that one code path only, and nothing would catch it since the value is a plain string, not a shared symbol.
recommendation: Add a single `const kLimudStageName = 'לימוד';` (near HebrewTerms.stageNameMap or in core/constants) and reference it from all 3 write sites instead of retyping the literal.
acceptance_criteria: grep -rn "stageName: 'לימוד'" lib/ returns only the shared constant's own definition, not literal duplicates at the 3 call sites

corrections: learning_process_wizard_service_test.dart and curriculum_defaults_test.dart both hardcode expect(stages.first.stageName, 'לימוד') independently of the source constant, so an isolated source-side typo in those two files would be caught by CI; stage_definition_repository_impl_test.dart / _26_26_test.dart never assert the Hebrew literal (they use 'Learn' fixtures instead), so that third copy is genuinely uncovered.
